text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, I came to the racecourse to watch Symboli Rudolf's race.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if we'll get to see that pose again today!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Of course we will! I mean, she's the "Emperor", isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: There's no way she's gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems most of the spectators came just to see Symboli Rudolf. I wonder how she herself is doing right now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading down to the underground tunnel—I find Symboli Rudolf standing with her eyes closed, listening intently to the roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Quite a packed house today.
The cheers resonate through my body more powerfully than ever.
choice_data_list: Everyone came to watch you win.
Everyone came to watch you win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is gratifying to hear. However, everyone has trained relentlessly for this day, polishing themselves to their absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today's race is particularly filled with elite contenders.
Even I cannot take victory for granted.
choice_data_list: You seem remarkably composed despite that.
You seem remarkably composed despite that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not necessarily. But if one trembles with fear at every step, their stride will only become distorted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Showing the world a victory claimed with timid, trembling footing would touch no one's heart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thus, I simply strive to walk this path with head held high and chest proud. That is all.
choice_data_list: To serve as a guiding signpost?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, who can say? Seeing is believing.
If you wish to know, then watch my race closely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—the gates to the decisive battle opened!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Coming out of the fourth corner's bend...
Surging from the inside, it's Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In the lead as expected, it's Symboli Rudolf! Utterly overwhelming!
Is defeat simply not an option for the "Emperor"?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Extending her lead, pulling further away...
Symboli Rudolf has done it once again—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With an overwhelmingly dominant performance, the race concluded with Symboli Rudolf's victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The venue, which by all rights should have erupted, fell into a mysterious, awe-struck silence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single finger was raised toward the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... Incredible! So cool, so cool, so cool!
Aaaah! Oh man, she's just way too amazing!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: That pose, that commanding presence... It feels like she's telling us, 'It's your turn next!'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
President... you really are incredible, hop!
To fire everyone up this much!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, President...
I'm definitely going to catch up to you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tell me, did my message reach you as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...No, forgive me.
It seems there is no need to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have a Winning Live to attend.
I shall take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as she walked away, she raised a single finger behind her back for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter how arduous the road ahead may be, she will surely continue to push forward, holding her ideals high.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To become the guiding light along this boundless path, so those following in her wake never lose their way...
